title: Teller refuses on camera to discuss Lazar

tellings.quote: I mean, I spoke to the guy before he went and interviewed Teller. He was one of Teller's students.

plain: In 1989 the physicist Edward Teller was asked on camera about Bob Lazar and refused to talk about him. Lazar himself tells Michels this, saying he spoke beforehand with the man who went to interview Teller, who had been one of Teller's students. Lazar sees the refusal as telling, since Teller would be someone who might know about the secret work Lazar describes.
